_intervals_comment: Eco-mode defaults. Each loop touches Upstash once per tick; Upstash's free tier caps you at 500K commands/month. Search loop starts at pollSearchIntervalSeconds and backs off to pollSearchIdleIntervalSeconds after a few empty pulls.

tvShowOverrides._comment: Two forms supported. Bare number = TMDB id. Object = { tmdbId, defaultSeason }. defaultSeason routes torrents without a parsed season (anime absolute numbering) into a specific Season XX folder, which Emby needs for series identification.

_searchProvider_comment: knaben | apibay | 1337x. knaben aggregates many indexers via api.knaben.org.
_pushStats_comment: Status push uses pushStatsIntervalSeconds while at least one torrent is moving bytes, and pushStatsIdleIntervalSeconds otherwise. The poller also fingerprint-skips relay POSTs when nothing has changed, so most idle ticks cost zero Redis commands.
